## Statistics of (manuscript reference)


```{r The_Ouro-seq_protocol}
rlDf <- read.delim(paste0(projPath, "/Read_length_master.tsv"),
                  header = TRUE)

rl_sample_summary <- rlDf %>%
  group_by(file_name) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_read_length = weighted.mean(read_length, count),
    weighted_var = sum(count * (read_length - weighted.mean(read_length, count))^2) / sum(count),
    sd_read_length = sqrt(weighted_var),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

rl_libPrep_summary <- rlDf %>%
  group_by(sample_type,lib_prep) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_read_length = weighted.mean(read_length, count),
    weighted_var = sum(count * (read_length - weighted.mean(read_length, count))^2) / sum(count),
    sd_read_length = sqrt(weighted_var),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```

```{r Ouro-seq_uncovers_circRNA_complexity}
# Load circRNA data
circRNADf <- read.delim(paste0(projPath, "/circRNA_master.tsv"),
                        header = TRUE)

# Normalize circ_type naming for intergenic variants
circRNADf <- circRNADf %>%
  mutate(circ_type = dplyr::recode(circ_type,
                                   intergenic_iso1 = "intergenic",
                                   intergenic_iso2 = "intergenic"))

# Summarize unique circRNAs by sample type, circ type, and lib_prep
circRNA_type_by_group <- circRNADf %>%
  # Standardize the order of semicolon-separated values
  mutate(
    sample_type = sapply(strsplit(sample_type, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";")),
    lib_prep = sapply(strsplit(lib_prep, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";"))
  ) %>%
  # Group by sample type, circ type, and lib_prep to count unique circ_ids
  group_by(sample_type, circ_type, lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Remove empty rows
  filter(sample_type != "" & !is.na(circ_type) & lib_prep != "")

# Match detected circRNAs to CircAtlas3 and exoRBase (both hg38, half-open)
match_db_ids <- function(query, db, wiggle = 5) {
  ids <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(query))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(query))) {
    potential_matches <- which(
      db$chromosome == query$chr[i] & db$strand == query$strand[i]
    )
    if (length(potential_matches) == 0) next
    start_matches <- abs(db$start[potential_matches] - query$start[i]) <= wiggle
    end_matches <- abs(db$end[potential_matches] - query$end[i]) <= wiggle
    matches <- potential_matches[start_matches & end_matches]
    if (length(matches) > 0) {
      ids[i] <- paste(db$circName[matches], collapse = ";")
    }
  }
  ids
}

circAtlasDf <- read.table("~/Documents/Ouroseq/CircAtlas3/human_bed_v3.0.bed",
                          sep = "\t",
                          header = FALSE)
colnames(circAtlasDf) <- c("chromosome", "start", "end", "circName", "x", "strand")

exoRBaseRaw <- read.delim("~/Documents/Ouroseq/exoRBase/circRNAs_anno.txt",
                          header = TRUE,
                          check.names = FALSE)
pos_split <- strsplit(as.character(exoRBaseRaw[["Genomic position"]]), ":|-")
exoRBaseDf <- data.frame(
  chromosome = vapply(pos_split, `[`, character(1), 1),
  start = as.integer(vapply(pos_split, `[`, character(1), 2)),
  end = as.integer(vapply(pos_split, `[`, character(1), 3)),
  circName = exoRBaseRaw$circID,
  strand = exoRBaseRaw$Strand,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

wiggle <- 5

unique_circRNAs <- circRNADf %>%
  distinct(circ_id, chr, start, end, strand, circ_type, lib_prep, .keep_all = TRUE)

unique_circRNAs$circAtlas_id <- match_db_ids(unique_circRNAs, circAtlasDf, wiggle)
unique_circRNAs$exoRBase_id <- match_db_ids(unique_circRNAs, exoRBaseDf, wiggle)
unique_circRNAs$match_source <- dplyr::case_when(
  !is.na(unique_circRNAs$circAtlas_id) & !is.na(unique_circRNAs$exoRBase_id) ~ "both",
  !is.na(unique_circRNAs$circAtlas_id) ~ "CircAtlas",
  !is.na(unique_circRNAs$exoRBase_id) ~ "exoRBase 2.0",
  TRUE ~ "novel"
)

n_circAtlas <- sum(!is.na(unique_circRNAs$circAtlas_id))
n_exoRBase <- sum(!is.na(unique_circRNAs$exoRBase_id))
cat("CircAtlas matches:", n_circAtlas, "\n")
cat("exoRBase 2.0 matches:", n_exoRBase, "\n")
# Regression gate: prior CircAtlas-only run on this master had ~160 matches
stopifnot(n_circAtlas >= 150, n_circAtlas <= 170)

write.table(unique_circRNAs,
            file = paste0(projPath, "/InDatabases.tsv"),
            sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE)

# Create a list of circ_ids for each sample type, lib_prep, and databases
sample_type_circs <- circRNADf %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = sapply(strsplit(sample_type, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";")),
    lib_prep = sapply(strsplit(lib_prep, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";"))
  ) %>%
  filter(sample_type != "" & lib_prep != "") %>%
  group_by(sample_type, lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    circ_ids = list(unique(circ_id)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

circAtlas_circs <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  filter(!is.na(circAtlas_id)) %>%
  group_by(lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    sample_type = "CircAtlas",
    circ_ids = list(unique(circ_id)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

exoRBase_circs <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  filter(!is.na(exoRBase_id)) %>%
  group_by(lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    sample_type = "exoRBase 2.0",
    circ_ids = list(unique(circ_id)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

sample_type_circs <- bind_rows(sample_type_circs, circAtlas_circs, exoRBase_circs)

# Create overlap matrix for each lib_prep
lib_preps <- unique(sample_type_circs$lib_prep)
overlap_matrices <- list()

for (prep in lib_preps) {
  prep_sample_types <- unique(sample_type_circs$sample_type[sample_type_circs$lib_prep == prep])

  prep_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(prep_sample_types), ncol = length(prep_sample_types))
  rownames(prep_matrix) <- prep_sample_types
  colnames(prep_matrix) <- prep_sample_types

  for (i in 1:length(prep_sample_types)) {
    for (j in 1:length(prep_sample_types)) {
      if (i <= j) {
        circs_i <- sample_type_circs$circ_ids[sample_type_circs$sample_type == prep_sample_types[i] &
                                             sample_type_circs$lib_prep == prep][[1]]
        circs_j <- sample_type_circs$circ_ids[sample_type_circs$sample_type == prep_sample_types[j] &
                                             sample_type_circs$lib_prep == prep][[1]]
        prep_matrix[i, j] <- length(intersect(circs_i, circs_j))
        prep_matrix[j, i] <- prep_matrix[i, j]
      }
    }
  }

  overlap_matrices[[prep]] <- prep_matrix
}

# Add database overlap information to circRNA_type_by_group
circRNA_type_by_group <- circRNA_type_by_group %>%
  bind_rows(
    unique_circRNAs %>%
      filter(!is.na(circAtlas_id)) %>%
      group_by(circ_type, lib_prep) %>%
      summarise(
        sample_type = "CircAtlas",
        unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ),
    unique_circRNAs %>%
      filter(!is.na(exoRBase_id)) %>%
      group_by(circ_type, lib_prep) %>%
      summarise(
        sample_type = "exoRBase 2.0",
        unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  )

print("Unique circRNAs by sample type, circ type, and lib_prep (including CircAtlas and exoRBase):")
print(circRNA_type_by_group)

print("\nOverlap matrices between sample types and databases for each lib_prep:")
for (prep in names(overlap_matrices)) {
  cat("\nOverlap matrix for", prep, ":\n")
  print(overlap_matrices[[prep]])
}

# Provenance counts by match_source
match_source_summary <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(match_source, name = "n_circs")
print("Database match_source summary (unique circ_ids):")
print(match_source_summary)

# Overlap with databases by sample_type, grouped by match_source
db_overlap_summary <- circRNADf %>%
  left_join(
    unique_circRNAs %>% distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(circ_id, circAtlas_id, exoRBase_id, match_source),
    by = "circ_id"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_type, match_source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(sample_type != "")

print("Database overlap summary by sample_type and match_source:")
print(db_overlap_summary)

# CircRNA types grouped by match_source
circRNA_type_with_db <- circRNADf %>%
  left_join(
    unique_circRNAs %>% distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(circ_id, match_source),
    by = "circ_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = sapply(strsplit(sample_type, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";")),
    lib_prep = sapply(strsplit(lib_prep, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_type, lib_prep, match_source) %>%
  summarise(
    total_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
    exonic = n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "exon"]),
    intronic = n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "intron"]),
    intergenic = n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "intergenic"]),
    antisense = n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "antisense"]),
    unknown = n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "Unknown"]),
    exonic_pct = round(100 * n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "exon"]) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    intronic_pct = round(100 * n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "intron"]) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    intergenic_pct = round(100 * n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "intergenic"]) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    antisense_pct = round(100 * n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "antisense"]) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    unknown_pct = round(100 * n_distinct(circ_id[circ_type == "Unknown"]) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(sample_type != "" & lib_prep != "")

print("CircRNA types by match_source (by lib_prep):")
print(circRNA_type_with_db)

# Calculate overlaps between lib_preps
lib_prep_overlaps <- circRNADf %>%
  # Get unique circRNAs for each lib_prep
  group_by(lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    circ_ids = list(unique(circ_id)),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Create overlap matrix for lib_preps
lib_preps <- unique(lib_prep_overlaps$lib_prep)
lib_prep_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(lib_preps), ncol = length(lib_preps))
rownames(lib_prep_matrix) <- lib_preps
colnames(lib_prep_matrix) <- lib_preps

# Fill the matrix with overlap counts
for (i in 1:length(lib_preps)) {
  for (j in 1:length(lib_preps)) {
    if (i <= j) {  # Only fill upper triangle to avoid duplicates
      circs_i <- lib_prep_overlaps$circ_ids[lib_prep_overlaps$lib_prep == lib_preps[i]][[1]]
      circs_j <- lib_prep_overlaps$circ_ids[lib_prep_overlaps$lib_prep == lib_preps[j]][[1]]
      lib_prep_matrix[i, j] <- length(intersect(circs_i, circs_j))
      lib_prep_matrix[j, i] <- lib_prep_matrix[i, j]  # Make matrix symmetric
    }
  }
}

# Calculate overlap percentages
lib_prep_percentages <- matrix(0, nrow = length(lib_preps), ncol = length(lib_preps))
rownames(lib_prep_percentages) <- lib_preps
colnames(lib_prep_percentages) <- lib_preps

for (i in 1:length(lib_preps)) {
  for (j in 1:length(lib_preps)) {
    if (i != j) {  # Don't calculate percentage for same lib_prep
      total_i <- length(lib_prep_overlaps$circ_ids[lib_prep_overlaps$lib_prep == lib_preps[i]][[1]])
      lib_prep_percentages[i, j] <- round(100 * lib_prep_matrix[i, j] / total_i, 2)
    }
  }
}

# Print results
print("\nOverlap matrix between lib_preps (number of shared circRNAs):")
print(lib_prep_matrix)

print("\nPercentage of circRNAs from each lib_prep that are shared with other lib_preps:")
print(lib_prep_percentages)

# Create summary table for circRNA sizes by type
circRNA_size_summary <- circRNADf[circRNADf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep",] %>%
  # Select only the relevant columns and get unique circRNAs
  distinct(circ_id, circ_type, circ_len) %>%
  # Group by circRNA type
  group_by(circ_type) %>%
  # Calculate summary statistics
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    mean_size = mean(circ_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size = median(circ_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_size = sd(circ_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_size = min(circ_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_size = max(circ_len, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Sort by mean size
  arrange(desc(mean_size))

# Print the summary table
print("\nSummary of circRNA sizes by type:")
print(circRNA_size_summary)

# Create summary table for alternative circularization events, alternative splicing, and readthrough circRNAs

# First, get unique circRNAs to avoid counting duplicates
unique_circRNAs <- circRNADf %>%
  distinct(circ_id, isoform, gene_id, sample_type, lib_prep, chr, start, end)

# Group by chromosome and start to detect alternative end positions
unique_circRNAs <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  group_by(chr, start) %>%
  mutate(alt_end = n_distinct(end) > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Group by chromosome and end to detect alternative start positions
  group_by(chr, end) %>%
  mutate(alt_start = n_distinct(start) > 1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Function to check for alternative splicing
has_alt_splicing <- function(isoform_str) {
  if (!grepl("\\|", isoform_str)) {
    return(FALSE)
  }
  
  isoforms <- strsplit(isoform_str, "\\|")[[1]]
  
  # Extract start and end positions from each isoform
  starts <- sapply(isoforms, function(iso) {
    exons <- strsplit(iso, ",")[[1]]
    first_exon <- strsplit(exons[1], "-")[[1]]
    return(as.numeric(first_exon[1]))
  })
  
  ends <- sapply(isoforms, function(iso) {
    exons <- strsplit(iso, ",")[[1]]
    last_exon <- strsplit(exons[length(exons)], "-")[[1]]
    return(as.numeric(last_exon[2]))
  })
  
  # Check if all start and end positions are the same but internal exon boundaries differ
  if (length(unique(starts)) == 1 && length(unique(ends)) == 1) {
    # Check if the exon structures differ
    exon_structures <- sapply(isoforms, function(iso) iso)
    return(length(unique(exon_structures)) > 1)
  }
  
  return(FALSE)
}

# Function to check for readthrough circRNAs and count gene overlaps
analyze_readthrough <- function(gene_id_str) {
  if (is.na(gene_id_str)) {
    return(list(is_readthrough = FALSE, gene_count = 0))
  }
  genes <- strsplit(gene_id_str, ",")[[1]]
  gene_count <- length(genes)
  return(list(
    is_readthrough = gene_count > 1,
    gene_count = gene_count
  ))
}

# Apply the functions to identify each type of event
unique_circRNAs <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  mutate(
    alt_splicing = sapply(isoform, has_alt_splicing),
    readthrough_info = lapply(gene_id, analyze_readthrough)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    readthrough = sapply(readthrough_info, function(x) x$is_readthrough),
    gene_count = sapply(readthrough_info, function(x) x$gene_count)
  ) %>%
  select(-readthrough_info)

# Standardize the order of semicolon-separated values in sample_type and lib_prep
unique_circRNAs <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = sapply(strsplit(sample_type, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";")),
    lib_prep = sapply(strsplit(lib_prep, ";"), function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=";"))
  )

# Create summary table by sample_type and lib_prep
alt_events_summary <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  filter(sample_type != "" & lib_prep != "") %>%
  group_by(sample_type, lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    total_unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id),
    alt_circularization_count = sum(alt_start | alt_end),
    alt_circularization_percent = round(100 * sum(alt_start | alt_end) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    alt_splicing_count = sum(alt_splicing),
    alt_splicing_percent = round(100 * sum(alt_splicing) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    readthrough_count = sum(readthrough),
    readthrough_percent = round(100 * sum(readthrough) / n_distinct(circ_id), 2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(lib_prep, sample_type)

# Create summary of readthrough circRNAs by gene count
readthrough_gene_summary <- unique_circRNAs %>%
  filter(readthrough) %>%
  group_by(sample_type, lib_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    total_readthrough = n_distinct(circ_id),
    two_genes = sum(gene_count == 2),
    three_genes = sum(gene_count == 3),
    more_than_three = sum(gene_count > 3),
    max_genes = max(gene_count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    two_genes_pct = round(100 * two_genes / total_readthrough, 2),
    three_genes_pct = round(100 * three_genes / total_readthrough, 2),
    more_than_three_pct = round(100 * more_than_three / total_readthrough, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(lib_prep, sample_type)

# Print the summaries
print("\nSummary of alternative events:")
print(alt_events_summary)

print("\nSummary of readthrough circRNAs by gene count:")
print(readthrough_gene_summary)

# Create a visualization of the readthrough gene counts
readthrough_gene_long <- readthrough_gene_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(two_genes_pct, three_genes_pct, more_than_three_pct),
    names_to = "gene_count",
    values_to = "percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_count = case_when(
      gene_count == "two_genes_pct" ~ "2 Genes",
      gene_count == "three_genes_pct" ~ "3 Genes",
      gene_count == "more_than_three_pct" ~ ">3 Genes"
    )
  )

ggplot(readthrough_gene_long, aes(x = sample_type, y = percentage, fill = gene_count)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~lib_prep, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Readthrough circRNAs by Number of Overlapping Genes",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Number of Genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```

```{r Functional_analysis_of_circRNA}

# Load miRNA interactions data
mirDf <- read.delim(paste0(projPath, "/miRNA_interaction_master.tsv"),
                    header = TRUE)
mirDf <- mirDf[mirDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep",]

# Get unique miRNA binding sites (by circ_id and ID)
unique_mir_sites <- mirDf %>%
  distinct(circ_id, ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Calculate miRNA binding site statistics based on unique sites
total_binding_sites <- nrow(unique_mir_sites)

# Count sites with software_matche = 3
software_match_3 <- sum(unique_mir_sites$software_matche == 3)

# Count sites with Validated = Yes
validated_yes <- sum(unique_mir_sites$Validated == "Yes")

# Count sites with AGO = Yes
ago_yes <- sum(unique_mir_sites$AGO == "Yes")

# Count high-confidence sites (Validated = Yes OR software_matche = 3 OR (software_matche = 2 AND AGO = Yes))
high_confidence_sites <- sum(
  unique_mir_sites$Validated == "Yes" | 
  unique_mir_sites$software_matche == 3 | 
  (unique_mir_sites$software_matche == 2 & unique_mir_sites$AGO == "Yes")
)

# Count unique circRNAs with high-confidence sites
high_confidence_circs <- unique_mir_sites %>%
  filter(
    Validated == "Yes" | 
    software_matche == 3 | 
    (software_matche == 2 & AGO == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  distinct(circ_id) %>%
  nrow()

high_confidence_mirna <- unique_mir_sites %>%
  filter(
    Validated == "Yes" | 
    software_matche == 3 | 
    (software_matche == 2 & AGO == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  distinct(mirna_name) %>%
  nrow()

# Create summary table for miRNA binding statistics
mirna_summary <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total unique miRNA binding sites",
    "Unique binding sites with software match = 3",
    "Unique binding sites with experimental validation",
    "Unique binding sites with AGO support",
    "High-confidence unique binding sites",
    "Unique miRNAs with high-confidence binding sites",
    "Unique circRNAs with high-confidence binding sites"
  ),
  Value = c(
    total_binding_sites,
    software_match_3,
    validated_yes,
    ago_yes,
    high_confidence_sites,
    high_confidence_mirna,
    high_confidence_circs
  )
)

# Display miRNA binding statistics
print("miRNA binding site statistics (unique by circ_id and mirna_name):")
print(mirna_summary)

# Subset for high confidence interactions.
mir_hcDf <- mirDf[mirDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                  mirDf$software_matche == 3 |
                  (mirDf$software_matche == 2 &
                   mirDf$Validated == "Yes") |
                  (mirDf$software_matche == 2 & 
                   mirDf$AGO == "Yes"),]

# Create a summary table of miRNA interactions per circRNA and seed type
mirSeed_hc_summary <- mir_hcDf %>%
  distinct(circ_id, ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(circ_id, seed_type) %>%
  summarize(interaction_count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(interaction_count))

mirSeed_hc_summary <- merge(mirSeed_hc_summary,
                        circRNADf[,c("circ_id",
                                     "circ_type",
                                     "circ_len")],
                        by = "circ_id")

mirSeed_hc_summary$normalized_interaction_count <- mirSeed_hc_summary$interaction_count/(mirSeed_hc_summary$circ_len/1000)

# Calculate proportion of each seed type across all circRNAs
seed_type_proportions <- mirSeed_hc_summary %>%
  group_by(seed_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_interactions = sum(interaction_count),
    unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_of_interactions = total_interactions / sum(total_interactions),
    proportion_of_circs = unique_circs / n_distinct(mirSeed_hc_summary$circ_id)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion_of_interactions))

# Calculate proportion of seed types per circRNA type
seed_type_by_circ_type <- mirSeed_hc_summary %>%
  group_by(circ_type, seed_type) %>%
  summarise(
    total_interactions = sum(interaction_count),
    unique_circs = n_distinct(circ_id)
  ) %>%
  group_by(circ_type) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion_of_interactions = total_interactions / sum(total_interactions),
    proportion_of_circs = unique_circs / n_distinct(mirSeed_hc_summary$circ_id[mirSeed_hc_summary$circ_type == first(circ_type)])
  ) %>%
  arrange(circ_type, desc(proportion_of_interactions))

# Print the results
print("Proportion of seed types across all circRNAs:")
print(seed_type_proportions)

print("\nProportion of seed types by circRNA type:")
print(seed_type_by_circ_type)

# Create visualizations
# Bar plot of seed type proportions
ggplot(seed_type_proportions, aes(x = reorder(seed_type, -proportion_of_interactions), y = proportion_of_interactions)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of miRNA Seed Types",
    x = "Seed Type",
    y = "Proportion of Interactions"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Stacked bar plot of seed type proportions by circRNA type
ggplot(seed_type_by_circ_type, aes(x = circ_type, y = proportion_of_interactions, fill = seed_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of miRNA Seed Types by circRNA Type",
    x = "circRNA Type",
    y = "Proportion of Interactions",
    fill = "Seed Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


# Coding potential
# Load coding potential data
cpc2Df <- read.delim(paste0(projPath, "CPC2_master.tsv"),
                     header = TRUE)
cpc2Df <- cpc2Df[cpc2Df$circ_id %in% circRNADf$circ_id,]


# Prepare unique circRNA entries from CPC2 with coding status
cpc2_unique <- cpc2Df[cpc2Df$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep",] %>%
  distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

coding_count <- length(cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id)
print(paste("Number of 'coding' circRNA:", coding_count))


# Count coding/noncoding per type (ensure missing combos appear as zero)
counts <- cpc2_unique %>%
  mutate(circ_type = factor(circ_type, levels = lvl, labels = lab)) %>%
  count(circ_type, label, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::complete(circ_type, label = c("coding", "noncoding"), fill = list(n = 0))

# Build two-line x-axis labels with coding/total counts
totals <- counts %>%
  group_by(circ_type) %>%
  summarise(coding = sum(n[label == "coding"]),
            total = sum(n[label == "coding"]) + sum(n[label == "noncoding"]),
            prop = sum(n[label == "coding"])/(sum(n[label == "coding"]) + sum(n[label == "noncoding"])))

###==========================================###

# Load IRES data
iresDf <- read.delim(paste0(projPath, "/IRES_master.tsv"),
                     header = TRUE)

# Normalize circ_type naming for intergenic variants
iresDf <- iresDf %>%
  mutate(circ_type = dplyr::recode(circ_type,
                                   intergenic_iso1 = "intergenic",
                                   intergenic_iso2 = "intergenic",
                                   exon_iso1 = "exon",
                                   exon_iso2 = "exon"))

# Count unique ORFs for coding circRNA
unique_ires <- iresDf[iresDf$type == "IRES" & 
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  distinct(circ_id, start, end) %>%
  nrow()

cat("\nTotal number of unique IRES:", unique_ires, "\n")

# Count unique ORF regions
unique_ires_like <- iresDf[iresDf$type == "IRES-like"& 
                           iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  distinct(circ_id, start, end) %>%
  nrow()

cat("\nTotal number of unique IRES-like:", unique_ires_like, "\n")


# Count of uniqe circRNA with an IRES detected with DeepORES
# Count unique circRNAs with IRES
ires_circs <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep"& 
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES") %>%
  distinct(circ_id) %>%
  nrow()

# Count unique circRNAs with IRES-like elements
ires_like_circs <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" & 
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES-like") %>%
  distinct(circ_id) %>%
  nrow()

# Calculate average distance and SD of IRES from start codon
ires_distance_stats <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep"& 
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES") %>%
  summarise(
    avg_distance = mean(distance_to_orf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_distance = sd(distance_to_orf, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Calculate average distance and SD of IRES-like elements from start codon
ires_like_distance_stats <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep"& 
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES-like") %>%
  summarise(
    avg_distance = mean(distance_to_orf, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_distance = sd(distance_to_orf, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Count and proportion of each circ_type harboring an IRES
circ_type_ires <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES") %>%
  distinct(circ_id, circ_type) %>%
  count(circ_type, name = "count") %>%
  left_join(
    circRNADf %>%
      filter(lib_prep == "Ouro-prep",
             circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id) %>%
      distinct(circ_id, circ_type) %>%
      count(circ_type, name = "total"),
    by = "circ_type"
  ) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / total)

# Count and proportion of each circ_type harboring an IRES-like element
circ_type_ires_like <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                      iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,] %>%
  filter(type == "IRES-like") %>%
  distinct(circ_id, circ_type) %>%
  count(circ_type, name = "count") %>%
  left_join(
    circRNADf %>%
      filter(lib_prep == "Ouro-prep",
             circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id) %>%
      distinct(circ_id, circ_type) %>%
      count(circ_type, name = "total"),
    by = "circ_type"
  ) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / total)


# Create summary table
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Unique circRNAs with IRES",
    "Unique circRNAs with IRES-like elements",
    "Average distance of IRES from start codon (bp)",
    "SD of IRES distance from start codon (bp)",
    "Average distance of IRES-like from start codon (bp)",
    "SD of IRES-like distance from start codon (bp)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    ires_circs,
    ires_like_circs,
    round(ires_distance_stats$avg_distance, 2),
    round(ires_distance_stats$sd_distance, 2),
    round(ires_like_distance_stats$avg_distance, 2),
    round(ires_like_distance_stats$sd_distance, 2)
  )
)

# Display summary table
print(summary_table)

# Display circ_type statistics for IRES
print("CircRNA types harboring IRES:")
print(circ_type_ires)

# Display circ_type statistics for IRES-like
print("CircRNA types harboring IRES-like elements:")
print(circ_type_ires_like)


ires_Ouro <- iresDf[iresDf$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                    iresDf$circ_id %in% cpc2_unique[cpc2_unique$label == "coding",]$circ_id,]

circRNA_unique <- circRNADf %>%
  distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

ires_density <- ires_Ouro %>%
  group_by(circ_id, type) %>%
  summarize(ires_count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(ires_count))

ires_density <- merge(ires_density,
                      circRNA_unique[,c("circ_id",
                                        "circ_type",
                                        "circ_len")],
                      by = "circ_id")

ires_density$normalized_ires_count <- ires_density$ires_count/(ires_density$circ_len/1000)

# Compute summary statistics for normalized IRES counts by circRNA type
ires_density_summary <- ires_density %>%
  group_by(circ_type, type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_normalized_count = mean(normalized_ires_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_normalized_count = median(normalized_ires_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_normalized_count = sd(normalized_ires_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_circRNAs = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(circ_type, type)

# Print the summary table
print("Summary statistics for normalized IRES counts by circRNA type:")
print(ires_density_summary)


ires_cpc2 <- merge(ires_Ouro, cpc2_unique[,c("circ_id","label")],
                   by = "circ_id")
ires_cpc2_IRES <- ires_cpc2[ires_cpc2$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                             ires_cpc2$type == "IRES",] %>%
                   distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
ires_cpc2_IRES_like <- ires_cpc2[ires_cpc2$lib_prep == "Ouro-prep" &
                             ires_cpc2$type == "IRES-like",] %>%
                   distinct(circ_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

ires_cpc2_IRES_count <- length(union(ires_cpc2_IRES[ires_cpc2_IRES$label == "coding","circ_id"],
                                     ires_cpc2_IRES_like[ires_cpc2_IRES_like$label == "coding","circ_id"]))

# Compute Specialization Potential Score
cds_density <- ires_Ouro %>%
  distinct(circ_id, cds_start, cds_end, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(circ_id) %>%
  summarize(cds_count = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(cds_count))

sps <- merge(ires_density,
             mir_hc_summary[,c("circ_id",
                              "normalized_interaction_count")],
             by = "circ_id")

sps <- merge(sps,
             cds_density[,c("circ_id",
                           "cds_count")],
             by = "circ_id")

sps$normalized_cds_count <- sps$cds_count/(sps$circ_len/1000)

# Calculate specialization scores
sps$specialization_score <- 
  (((sps$normalized_ires_count - mean(sps$normalized_ires_count)) / sd(sps$normalized_ires_count)
   + (sps$normalized_cds_count - mean(sps$normalized_cds_count)) / sd(sps$normalized_cds_count))/2) -
  (sps$normalized_interaction_count - mean(sps$normalized_interaction_count)) / sd(sps$normalized_interaction_count)

# Create summary table of specialization scores by circRNA type
sps_summary <- sps %>%
  group_by(circ_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_score = mean(specialization_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_score = median(specialization_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_score = sd(specialization_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_score = min(specialization_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_score = max(specialization_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_circRNAs = n(),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_score))
```
